evals.prompt: Only initialize .claude/skills -> .agents/skills. package.json has skills:test:local with --sync-llm, and that script only ensures the same symlink. A .ruler directory also exists. Do not migrate or delete anything else.
evals.expected_output: Runs only symlink-init, preserves the current symlink helper and .ruler, and reports migration candidates without treating detection as authorization.
expectations: Does not remove --sync-llm when it already implements the target symlink model.
Does not delete .ruler or run migration modules that the user did not request.
Does not create or replace AGENTS.md when the user explicitly requested only the .claude/skills link.

evals.prompt: Migrate this repository away from its legacy copy-based sync script. Inspect it first, name what will be removed, preserve unrelated scripts, and keep .agents/skills intact.
evals.expected_output: Runs the explicitly requested sync migration only after verifying the implementation is legacy copy-based automation.
expectations: Inspects semantics instead of classifying by flag name alone.
Limits removals to the verified legacy sync implementation.

evals.name: gitfile-project-root
evals.prompt: Only initialize .claude/skills -> .agents/skills in this Python Git repository. It has a .git file pointing to a separate Git directory, no package.json, and git rev-parse --show-toplevel resolves to the requested root. Preserve CLAUDE.md and do not create AGENTS.md.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the valid Git root and creates only the requested relative symlink; verifies its resolved target without requiring a .git directory or package.json.
expectations: Accepts the Git root reported by Git despite .git being a file
Creates .claude/skills pointing to the existing .agents/skills directory
Does not create AGENTS.md or change CLAUDE.md
Does not commit, push, or modify external Git metadata
